{{Nihongo|'''Makoto Asashima'''|浅島 誠|Asashima Makoto|born 1944}} is a Japanese [[developmental biologist]] known for his pioneer research on [[Activin]]. He is Professor Emeritus of the [[University of Tokyo]] and [[Yokohama City University]]. He is also Vice President of the [[Tokyo University of Science]].<ref>[https://www.tus.ac.jp/ridai/doc/ji/RIJIA01Detail.php?act=nam&kin=ken&diu=6c9b&pri=enl ASASHIMA Makoto] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190114044503/https://www.tus.ac.jp/ridai/doc/ji/RIJIA01Detail.php?act=nam&kin=ken&diu=6c9b&pri=enl |date=2019-01-14 }} RIDAI</ref>

==Contribution==
Asashima and his colleagues identified [[Activin]] in 1990, which exhibits a wide range of biological activities including regulation of cellular proliferation and differentiation.<ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Asashima | first1 = M. | last2 = Nakano | first2 = H. | last3 = Shimada | first3 = K. | last4 = Kinoshita | first4 = K. | last5 = Ishii | first5 = K. | last6 = Shibai | first6 = H. | last7 = Ueno | first7 = N. | doi = 10.1007/BF00383771 | title = Mesodermal induction in early amphibian embryos by activin A (erythroid differentiation factor) | journal = Roux's Archives of Developmental Biology | volume = 198 | issue = 6 | pages = 330–335 | year = 1990 | pmid = 28305412 | s2cid = 20766573 }}</ref>

==Biography==
Asashima was born in [[Sado, Niigata]] in 1944.<ref name="brh">[http://www.brh.co.jp/s_library/j_site/scientistweb/no76/ “変わらない熱情で、中胚葉へと変わる過程を見る” Biography of Makoto Asashima] {{in lang|ja}}</ref> He graduated from [[Tokyo University of Education]] in March 1967, and received his Ph.D. from [[The University of Tokyo]] in 1972.<ref name="aist">{{cite web|url= https://unit.aist.go.jp/scrc/cie/intro/asashima_en.html|title= Makoto Asashima, Ph.D.|date= August 2010|publisher= Advanced Industrial Science Technology|location= Japan|archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20140202105448/https://unit.aist.go.jp/scrc/cie/intro/asashima_en.html|archive-date= 2014-02-02|access-date= 29 January 2014|url-status= dead}}</ref> He was a [[postdoctoral fellow]] under Heinz Tiedemann at [[Free University of Berlin]] between 1972 and 1974, and a member of the faculty of [[Yokohama City University]] between 1972 and 1993, before being appointed as a professor at [[The University of Tokyo]] in 1993.<ref name="aist"/>
